rows.strand: Content knowledge and its application within and across curriculum areas
rows.2: Apply knowledge of content within and across curriculum teaching areas.
rows.3: Model effective applications of content knowledge within and across curriculum teaching areas.

rows.strand: Strategies for promoting literacy and numeracy
rows.2: Use a range of teaching strategies that enhance learner achievement in literacy and numeracy skills.
rows.3: Evaluate with colleagues the effectiveness of teaching strategies that promote learner achievement in literacy and numeracy.

rows.strand: Strategies for developing critical and creative thinking, as well as other higher-order thinking skills
rows.2: Apply a range of teaching strategies to develop critical and creative thinking, as well as other higher-order thinking skills.
rows.3: Develop and apply effective teaching strategies to promote critical and creative thinking, as well as other higher-order thinking skills.

rows.strand: Mother Tongue, Filipino and English in teaching and learning
rows.2: Display proficient use of Mother Tongue, Filipino and English to facilitate teaching and learning.
rows.3: Model and support colleagues in the proficient use of Mother Tongue, Filipino and English to improve teaching and learning, as well as to develop the learners’ pride of their language, heritage and culture.

rows.2: Establish safe and secure learning environments to enhance learning through the consistent implementation of policies, guidelines and procedures.
rows.3: Exhibit effective strategies that ensure safe and secure learning environments to enhance learning through the consistent implementation of policies, guidelines and procedures.

rows.2: Maintain learning environments that promote fairness, respect and care to encourage learning.
rows.3: Exhibit effective practices to foster learning environments that promote fairness, respect and care to encourage learning.

rows.strand: Learners’ linguistic, cultural, socio-economic and religious backgrounds
rows.2: Establish a learner-centered culture by using teaching strategies that respond to their linguistic, cultural, socio-economic and religious backgrounds.
rows.3: Exhibit a learner-centered culture that promotes success by using effective teaching strategies that respond to their linguistic, cultural, socio-economic and religious backgrounds.

rows.2: Adapt and use culturally appropriate teaching strategies to address the needs of learners from indigenous groups.
rows.3: Develop and apply teaching strategies to address effectively the needs of learners from indigenous groups.

rows.2: Use strategies for providing timely, accurate and constructive feedback to improve learner performance.
rows.3: Use effective strategies for providing timely, accurate and constructive feedback to encourage learners to reflect on and improve their own learning.
